chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn 'Amira, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever seeks the pleasure of the people with what angers Allah, Mighty and Majestic, his praisers from the people will be condemners; and whoever prefers the obedience of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, even if it annoys the people, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will suffice him with the enmity of every enemy, the envy of every envious one, and the aggression of every aggressor, and Allah will be for him a Helper and a Supporter.'
ai.seo_question: What happens if I please people by disobeying God?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) elucidates the theological principle of *al-wala' wa al-bar'a* by contrasting the instability of human approval with the permanence of divine support. It serves as a practical guide for believers facing social pressure, assuring that prioritizing God's commandments, even at the cost of public opinion, guarantees Allah's protection from the enmity of all adversaries.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who seeks the pleasure of the people with what Angers Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, his praisers from the people would be condemners; and the one who prefers the obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with what abhors the people, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Suffice him with the enmity of every enemy, and envy of every envious one, and rebellion of every rebel, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be a Helper of his and a Backer’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Isma’il ibn Mehran from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from ‘Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir from abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam , who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, Those who seek to please people by means of things that displease Allah, the most Majestic, the most Glorious, people who praise them turn to blame them. Those who prefer to obey Allah, the most Majestic, the most Glorious, by means of things that displease people, Allah, the most Majestic, the most Glorious, suffices them against the animosity of all enemies, jealousy of all jealous ones, the transgression of all transgressors and Allah is their helper and supporter.”’
